# Method GetUnitSymbol

#### GetUnitSymbol(UnitType, int)

Gets the symbol of a unit in English.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 6, 0, 0)]
string GetUnitSymbol(UnitType inUnitType, int inUnitIndex)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  UnitType |  inUnitType |  Unit type.  |  
 
|  int |  inUnitIndex |  Unit index.  |  

##### Returns

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  string |  Symbol of the unit in English.  |  

##### Remarks

This method is available since v7.6.
